HCLTech Partners with Anthropic for AI Business Unit

HCLTech has signed a pact with Anthropic to establish a dedicated business unit focused on agentic AI solutions. This partnership aims to combine HCLTech's industry expertise with Anthropic's AI products to develop enterprise solutions that incorporate stronger safeguards.
